summary_md: **Beamsters ([@Beamsters1](https://x.com/Beamsters1/status/2115035083694555148))** releases a **DeepSeek 4.1 Flash 1017 STQ-1.75bpw** quant with **Sushi 1.4.0**, an Apple-silicon engine: 1M context on 96GB and 128GB Macs, ~1,000 tok/s prefill, 75 code / 45 prose tok/s. Self-replies add a quality chart vs oQ2.5e, per-memory throughput, and a Tool Eval Bench 3.0.0 report.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - beamivalice/sushi: Sushi engine runs very high quality quant model in Apple Silicon, using both STQ and EXL3 format with special tuning technology.

relevance: Max-tier DeepSeek running on a single Mac at very low bit-width, with tool-eval results.

media.description: Grim-reaper animation rendered by the DeepSeek 4.1 Flash STQ-1.75bpw quant running in Sushi, per the post (not downloaded; referenced only).

Bar chart 'DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash · KLD by category' comparing Sushi STQ 1.75bpw with oQ2.5e oMLX (2.96bpw) against the original checkpoint across code, math, reasoning, design, wikitext, multilingual, story and science; overall KLD 0.1843 vs 0.1717 with ~89% top-1 agreement.
